notes: South Pemiscot County R-V, Board Policy Manual, JGA-1 CORPORAL PUNISHMENT, header '(Permitted)'. The policy page's own dates: 'Original Adopted Date: 11/13/2014 | Last Revised Date: 08/16/2022 | Last Reviewed Date: 08/16/2022 | Status: ADOPTED'; footer 'Version JGA-1C.1D (08/22)', (c) 2022 Missouri School Boards' Association. CLASSIFIED consent_required, NOT allows: the policy permits corporal punishment in general but conditions every use on affirmative advance written permission from the parent/guardian (opt IN), which is the quoted sentence. The district still reported striking 52 students in CRDC 2023-24. Simbli site 356 identity confirmed twice: the page title is 'Policy Listing | South Pemiscot R-V', and the district's own homepage southpemiscot.com links 'Board Policies' to SB_PolicyOverview.aspx?S=356&Sch=356. fetch_simbli_policy returned the vendor bot-challenge on every one of ~10 spaced attempts over more than two hours (reported as issue_8839706bb552), so this policy was read in a browser through the manual's own keyword search and source_text is supplied.
